title: Casa Yalku
subtitle: Contemporary elegance on the golf course
description:
The Emerald Estate
Perfectly positioned facing the golf course within the highly sought-after Caleta Yalku area of Puerto Aventuras, this luxury residence redefines the standards of coastal engineering. Designed with a contemporary architectural approach, the property effortlessly combines absolute energy efficiency with timeless elegance. It is a space created to offer total peace of mind and an exceptional level of comfort under the Riviera Maya sun.

The Fluidity of Spaces
Built on a 5,167 sq ft lot, the home unfolds over 4,844 sq ft of remarkably insulated interior spaces, maintained at a perfect temperature by two central air conditioning units. The intelligent layout centers around a vast living room, a luminous dining area, and a high-end fitted kitchen. The design includes a private office, a game room, and a television lounge, while the upper level reserves four spacious bedrooms and luxurious bathrooms to welcome guests in complete comfort.

An Oasis of Privacy
The exterior is conceived as an immersive reception space, featuring a large swimming pool, a Jacuzzi, and a superbly integrated outdoor kitchen. The excellence of this property also lies in its formidable, invisible technical design. Elevated more than four feet from the ground to eliminate humidity and guarantee a healthy structure, it benefits from double-block walls with thermal insulation, large hurricane-protection windows, solar panels, and an advanced water purification system.

The Lifestyle
Offered fully furnished, this residence ensures a real estate transition with absolutely zero friction. Living here means enjoying the ultra-secure environment of Puerto Aventuras, with immediate access to the marina and beaches, while benefiting from fiber optic connectivity for global activities. It is a rare opportunity to own a robust and sophisticated asset in a prime location.
